title: Harden CI per DEC-240: no lifecycle scripts, no persisted credentials, exact Quest version, env-passed outputs
description: DEC-240 (opum-doc, 2026-10-25 14:10Z; plan item 13 approved dec-00icl6f = A, 2026-10-26T13:43:57Z). DEC-182 (1) floor work: authored at Sonnet or above, Opus reviews before landing. Measured on origin/dev 84ce155: the only workflow is .github/workflows/ci.yml (three jobs). (1) Docs installs lore and Tracker installs quest with plain npm install --global, so dependency lifecycle scripts run on the runner. (2) All three checkout steps use the default persist-credentials; no job pushes. (3) The Quest version is read by sed 's/.*Quest CLI \([0-9][0-9.]*\).*/\1/' anywhere in CLAUDE.md, not bounded by the managed block markers and not shape-checked. (4) The Quest version step output reaches the install step through env: already (item 4 satisfied by measurement; keep it so). Bun install in the Check job is not lore/quest; item 1 does not apply to it. Not in scope: SHA-pinning third-party actions (taken to grooming). Landing is held for the Opus review.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Both npm installs of @opum-ai/lore and @opum-ai/quest in .github/workflows/ci.yml use npm install -g --ignore-scripts with the exact version, and a proof records that an install of a package whose dependency carries a deliberately failing postinstall still succeeds under that command while failing without --ignore-scripts.

Every actions/checkout step in every workflow sets persist-credentials: false, or, where its job pushes with the token, keeps it with a comment saying why; a fetch needing the token is solved by checkout fetch-depth/ref, not by an exemption.

The Quest version is read only from between the managed Quest block markers in CLAUDE.md and must match ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ exactly; any other value (partial version, missing markers, absent line) fails the job by name and never reaches npm, with a proof that a CLAUDE.md carrying a partial version fails the read by name and the real CLAUDE.md passes.
No step output is interpolated as ${{ }} inside a run: block in any workflow; each reaches its shell step through env:.
The pull request is green on its head SHA in Docs, Tracker integrity and Check, and the commands and outcomes of both-ways proofs are recorded on the task.

implementationNotes: Proof 1 (item 1; npm 11.21.1 stands for the npm a node 24 runner carries, because local npm 12.2.0 blocks dependency scripts by default and cannot show the control). Fixture: top-pkg depending on bad-dep whose postinstall is 'exit 1', both from packed tarballs. 'npx npm@11 install -g --prefix P top-pkg.tgz' -> rc=1, 'command sh -c echo POSTINSTALL-RAN; exit 1' failed. Same with --ignore-scripts -> rc=0, 'added 2 packages', bad-dep present. Script: scratchpad proof2.sh.

Proof 2 (item 3), .github/scripts/read-quest-version.sh FILE. Rejects by name, rc=1: 'Quest CLI 0.14' (partial) -> Quest version '0.14' is not an exact X.Y.Z; also ^0.14.1, 0.14.1., latest, 0.14.1-rc.1; markers removed -> 'managed Quest block begin marker not found'; 'Quest CLI 9.9.9' outside the block with none inside -> 'no Quest CLI <version> line inside the managed Quest block'. Accepts: real CLAUDE.md -> 0.14.1, rc=0. Script: scratchpad proof.sh. Items 2 and 4: all three checkout steps set persist-credentials: false (no job pushes, none runs a later git fetch); every dollar-brace-brace in ci.yml is the concurrency group or the env: QUEST_VERSION line, none inside run:.

RERUNNABLE PROOF 1 (item 1). Run with 'bash proof2.sh'; needs network for 'npx npm@11'. Under npm 12 the control cannot fail (blocks dep scripts by default); 'npx -y npm@11 install ...' in place of 'npm install' gives the runner-like control. Observed: npm 11.21.1 without flag rc=1 (POSTINSTALL-RAN, command failed); with --ignore-scripts rc=0, bad-dep present. Script text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# DEC-240 item 1 proof: a dependency with a failing postinstall.
P=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Volumes-external-repos-glyph-cli/56653f45-4c3a-4931-ab96-e0c636592c63/scratchpad/q
rm -rf "$P"; mkdir -p "$P/dep" "$P/top"; cd "$P"
echo '{"name":"bad-dep","version":"1.0.0","scripts":{"postinstall":"echo POSTINSTALL-RAN; exit 1"}}' > dep/package.json
(cd dep && npm pack --pack-destination .. >/dev/null 2>&1)
echo "{\"name\":\"top-pkg\",\"version\":\"1.0.0\",\"bin\":{\"top\":\"t.js\"},\"dependencies\":{\"bad-dep\":\"file:$P/bad-dep-1.0.0.tgz\"}}" > top/package.json
echo '#!/usr/bin/env node' > top/t.js
(cd top && npm pack --pack-destination .. >/dev/null 2>&1)
echo "npm $(npm --version)"
echo "--- without --ignore-scripts"
npm install -g --prefix "$P/pre1" "$P/top-pkg-1.0.0.tgz" > o1 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; grep -v '^npm notice' o1 | tail -6
echo "--- with --ignore-scripts"
npm install -g --ignore-scripts --prefix "$P/pre2" "$P/top-pkg-1.0.0.tgz" > o2 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; tail -2 o2
echo "installed dep:"; ls "$P/pre2/lib/node_modules/top-pkg/node_modules"

RERUNNABLE PROOF 2 (item 3), after review fixes F1-F4 (d240-glyph-fix). Run from repo root: bash proof3.sh. Observed: partial 0.14, 0.14.1., 0.14.1-rc.1 -> 'is not an exact X.Y.Z'; latest, version only outside block -> no Quest CLI version line inside the block; markers gone / two blocks / lone begin -> 'markers: expected exactly one begin and one end marker, found N begin and M end'; reversed -> 'markers: the end marker comes before the begin marker'; CRLF -> 'has CRLF line endings; the markers cannot match'; prose 'Quest CLI version note, then Quest CLI 1.2.3' -> 1.2.3 rc=0; real CLAUDE.md -> 0.14.1 rc=0. Script text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# DEC-240 item 3 proof, rerunnable: bash proof3.sh (from the repo root).
R=.github/scripts/read-quest-version.sh
D="$(mktemp -d)"
B='<!-- quest:agent-instructions:begin -->'
E='<!-- quest:agent-instructions:end -->'
row() { # name, file ; prints name, stderr, rc
  echo "== $1"; bash "$R" "$2"; echo "rc=$?"
}
sed 's/Quest CLI 0.14.1/Quest CLI 0.14/' CLAUDE.md > "$D/partial.md"; row partial "$D/partial.md"
for v in 0.14.1. 0.14.1-rc.1; do sed "s/Quest CLI 0.14.1/Quest CLI $v/" CLAUDE.md > "$D/v.md"; row "$v" "$D/v.md"; done
sed 's/Quest CLI 0.14.1/Quest CLI latest/' CLAUDE.md > "$D/v.md"; row "latest (not digit-led)" "$D/v.md"
grep -v 'quest:agent-instructions' CLAUDE.md > "$D/nm.md"; row "markers gone" "$D/nm.md"
printf 'Quest CLI 9.9.9\n%s\nno line\n%s\n' "$B" "$E" > "$D/ob.md"; row "version only outside block" "$D/ob.md"
printf '%s\nno line\n%s\n%s\nQuest CLI 9.9.9\n%s\n' "$B" "$E" "$B" "$E" > "$D/two.md"; row "two blocks, version only in second" "$D/two.md"
printf '%s\nQuest CLI 1.2.3\n%s\n' "$E" "$B" > "$D/rev.md"; row "reversed markers" "$D/rev.md"
printf '%s\nQuest CLI 1.2.3\n' "$B" > "$D/lone.md"; row "lone begin" "$D/lone.md"
sed 's/$/\r/' CLAUDE.md > "$D/crlf.md"; row "CRLF" "$D/crlf.md"
printf '%s\nQuest CLI version note, then Quest CLI 1.2.3 here\n%s\n' "$B" "$E" > "$D/prose.md"; row "prose before the version (expect 1.2.3)" "$D/prose.md"
row "real CLAUDE.md (expect 0.14.1)" CLAUDE.md

FOLLOW-UP, not built here (review F5): the Check job runs 'bun install --frozen-lockfile', which runs dependency lifecycle scripts on the runner; outside DEC-240 (lore/quest installs only). Candidate: --ignore-scripts there, or a trusted-dependencies list, as a separate task. ci.yml install steps now also log 'npm --version' beside the lore and quest version lines (F6).
